caseName: Security-First National Bank of Los Angeles v. Franchise Tax Board
caseNameFull: SECURITY-FIRST NATIONAL BANK OF LOS ANGELES v. FRANCHISE TAX BOARD OF CALIFORNIA
attorneys: Pierce Works, Warren M. Christopher, Hugo A. Stein-meyer, Richard E. Sherwood and Brenton L. Metzler for appellants., Stanley Mosk, Attorney General of California, James E. Sabine, Assistant Attorney General, and Ernest P. Goodman, Deputy Attorney General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
